_note: SpeedKills' signature guns in the hands (src/game/viewmodel.ts, src/game/phase.ts). The owner (2026-09-27): tear through two guns, the USSO and BOOG, top tier animations, swapping, recoil, reloading, and have them phase in like Hyper Scape did; not realistic, futuristic. A gun listed here phases in and out of the hands instead of dropping out of the frame, kicks on its own spring, pulses its glow on a shot and phases its magazine out and a new one in on a reload. Ours, by eye against pictures and the game's own shot rates; every time is a share of the swap, the holster or the reload, every length metres in the gun's space, every turn radians.
_phase: The sweep (phase.ts), after Hyper Scape's: a gun half built from dark pixel cubes with a glowing amber band sweeping along it (research of its footage, 2026-09-27). color is the band's amber, the hack cards' (viewmodel.json hackCast); cube the cubes ahead of it, dark with the band's light on their edges (they were bright cyan); band, the lit edge's width, and jag, how far a cell may push the edge back, both shares of the gun's length; cell, the cell's size, a share of the length too, so the edge steps like pixels; lines, the scanlines along the gun, per length; ahead, how far ahead of the edge the scatter of flickering cells reaches, as a share of the length, and scatter, how thick it is at the edge.
_guns: Per gun. swap: the outgoing gun phases out over `out` of the swap and the incoming one in over `in` (the model changes at the swap's middle), and `move` is how much of the old drop out of the frame is kept (none would hide nothing from a player's eye; all of it would hide the phase); as it phases in it rises `rise` and unrolls `roll`. holster: the same over the holster's own fraction. kick: the recoil, a spring of its own (`spring` stiffness and `damp` damping, a shot adding `impulse` to its speed), moving the gun `back` and turning it `up`, `yaw` and `roll` a unit of it; buzz: a shake while firing, `amp` metres at `hz`. pulse: the glow jumps by `glow` times on a shot and falls back over `decay` s. charge (BOOG): over the rechamber the glow drains to `drained` and builds back, with a flash of `ready` as it is ready again. reload: the magazine drops `drop` (the plain reload's 0.32 took it out of the frame, and its phase with it) and phases out over `magOut`, the new one in over `magIn`, and it seats at `seat` with a snap of `snap` on the kick spring and a pulse. flash: the muzzle's own flash, its colour, its size against the plain one, how long it lasts (s) and a shockwave ring off the muzzle (0 none, 1 BOOG's). shell: `cell`, a glowing energy casing that shrinks away as it falls, for brass. rack (USSO): on a reload from empty the charging handle goes back and forward over that share of it, after the seat. scan: a lit band passing along the whole gun, `inspect` passes over an inspect and `fusion` seconds when the gun fuses up. ads: the glow's pulse going into the sights. lowAmmo: below that share of the magazine the glow flickers, a tell that it is nearly out. scope (BOOG): its magnified picture powers on over `boot` s, a scan line drawing the reticle top to bottom, and a ring round the picture fills as the gun recharges. hip: moves the gun's hip pose (x right, y up, z back, metres before the view's scale): the USSO's sat low in the right corner at 1920 by 1080 and 110 degrees, half under the HUD's gun panel (the owner: too far down to see its animations).

sentinel._scope: style hs: Hyper Scape's Protocol V scope (hud.ts drawHsScope): the whole screen, a soft chamfered frame, thin red lines across it with range ticks, a post above and stadia below, the zoom beside a chevron at the left edge; the recharge a bar under it.

_spin: The draw's spin (viewmodel.ts), after Hyper Scape's: PC Gamer, "switching between weapons spins the gun ahead of you like a fractured boomerang, materialising your secondary weapon before your eyes and returning it fully-formed back into your hand". While a signature gun phases in or out it turns `turns` times flat, like a thrown boomerang, about its own middle, `ahead` metres further out and `up` higher than the hand, and comes back into the grip as it comes whole. fuse: a fusion floods the gun (its phase dips to `dip` and comes back over `seconds`), Hyper Scape's gold pixel flood as a gun fused up.
_hs: From the second Hyper Scape research pass (docs/HYPERSCAPE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md): screen, a live screen on the gun's left side, as Hyper Scape's guns carried (the Protocol V's showed its magazine in blue digits with fusion pips): its middle at `y` and `z` in the model's space, `w` by `h` metres, standing just proud of the side there (measured off the model as it loads); digits in `color`, the pips gold at the top level (Game Informer: max a weapon out and it turns golden). tracer: the round's streak in `color`, `width` times as wide (the Protocol V's "thick, blue bullet tracer"). The USSO's flash is warm, the Ripper's orange-yellow, timed to its rate of fire.
